exhibits.title: Organisational chart and delegation of authority
Data Infrastructure Review - Vendor of the Year

c1.label: Revenue $320M - 1,800 employees
c1.text: Global revenue reached $320M in FY2023, with 1,800 employees across eleven offices.

c2.label: Data Infrastructure Vendor of the Year
c2.text: Northwind Data Systems was named Data Infrastructure Vendor of the Year for 2023.

c3.label: 13 of the 20 largest retailers in North America
c3.text: Its platform serves 13 of the 20 largest retailers in North America.

c4.label: Reports to the CTO - 4 teams, 47 people
c4.text: The Director of AI Research reports directly to the Chief Technology Officer and oversees four research teams comprising 47 researchers.

c5.label: Final approval over a $12M budget
c5.text: Final approval authority over the division's $12M annual R&D budget rests with the Director of AI Research.

c6.label: Retrieval rebuild cut query latency 60%
c6.text: The retrieval infrastructure rebuild that Dr. Li led reduced median query latency by 60% across our platform.

c7.label: Led Project Atlas - delivered 2022 Q3
c7.text: Project Atlas was initiated and led by Dr. Li, and was delivered in Q3 2022.

c8.label: SIGMOD 2022 Best Paper Award
c8.text: Best Paper Award presented to Dr. Wei Li et al. for “Efficient Query Processing in Large-Scale Distributed Databases.”

c9.label: VLDB 2023 programme committee invitation
c9.text: We invite Dr. Wei Li to serve on the Program Committee for VLDB 2023.

c10.label: Conference registration figures
c10.text: Registration for the 2023 meeting totalled 2,140 attendees.
